subject: Carry-on kit split-shipment + local kitting contingency
messages:
From: LumaPromo <hello@lumapromo.com>

Cc: MidwestConf Ops <ops@midwestconf.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LP-9227 quote + production flag (material delay)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the opportunity to support Redwood's carry-on kits for MidwestConf. Quick update: we ran the color run samples this morning and the supplier flagged a 10-14 day delay on the woven label material. That affects the final tote assembly timeline.

Options we can offer to keep your on-site delivery date intact:
- Split ship: produce 70% of items (tote + sticker + insert) on time and ship to the venue via express LTL; hold 30% until woven labels arrive and ship later (we can kitting-swap on-site).
- Alternate: switch to a printed patch instead of woven label (no delay) — proof attached.
- Local kitting: we can deliver bulk components to a local partner for final fold/kitting at venue site (saves freight and reduces risk).

Attached: promo-tote-final-proof.pdf (printed-patch option highlighted), quote_LP-9227.xlsx (itemized, includes express shipping premium).

If you want the split-ship approach, please confirm quantities for the express wave and we'll issue revised PO + invoice.

Cheers,
Alex Howard
Account Manager | LumaPromo
Attachment: promo-tote-final-proof.pdf (PDF proof, 3 pages)
Attachment: quote_LP-9227.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

2) Confirm whether the printed-patch option changes the lead time or cost materially.

We prefer to avoid last-minute local kitting unless freight costs make it necessary — but please include a local kitting estimate for reference.

PO: Redwood PO# RWI-2026-318 (place-holder until we have final invoice).

Looping in Marissa and Laura for logistics and day-of ops.
